showcase_positioning.thesis: A Maya-hosted AI Tool TA portfolio that turns one asset handoff into protocol, gate, review, delivery, and batch evidence.
showcase_positioning.module_shell_explanation: The shell is the DCC presentation and evidence orchestration layer; the five modules are business stages in one asset publish chain, and Asset Handoff Gate is the composite gate that proves the chain can be evaluated as a batch.

presentation_route.business_question: How does the scene carry gameplay/publish semantics without relying on file naming alone?
presentation_route.operator_action: Open Asset Protocol Workbench, publish the active payload, then inspect it from Maya Bridge.
presentation_route.core_logic: Encode role, platform, LOD, collision, and budget into a stable custom attr payload that downstream tools can parse.
presentation_route.evidence_to_show: Maya node custom attr, inspected protocol rows, DCC evidence JSON.
presentation_route.reviewer_value: Shows schema ownership and DCC-native metadata strategy.

presentation_route.business_question: Can the tool turn project rules into repeatable DCC facts, failures, and fix previews?
presentation_route.operator_action: Run Collect Scene, Validate Scene, Preview Fixes, and Export DCC Report.
presentation_route.core_logic: Collect scene facts, evaluate deterministic rules, separate safe_auto fixes from manual_only decisions.
presentation_route.evidence_to_show: Rule results, fix preview rows, rule-matrix artifact.
presentation_route.reviewer_value: Shows production gate design instead of ad hoc checking.

presentation_route.business_question: How does subjective art review become a fixed camera/pass contract?
presentation_route.operator_action: Create the review camera rig, build pass manifest, preview capture, and export review evidence.
presentation_route.core_logic: Generate canonical cameras and pass rows from the scene so review output can be compared later.
presentation_route.evidence_to_show: Camera rig nodes, pass manifest, capture preview paths.
presentation_route.reviewer_value: Shows review standardization and repeatable visual evidence.

presentation_route.business_question: Can texture handoff be checked against naming, color space, source path, and budget rules?
presentation_route.operator_action: Create the texture fixture, inspect file nodes, validate the scene, and export the manifest.
presentation_route.core_logic: Scan shading networks and file nodes, infer texture roles, compare actual color space/path/budget against policy.
presentation_route.evidence_to_show: Material/file node rows, validation gates, texture-delivery manifest.
presentation_route.reviewer_value: Shows the bridge between DCC material graphs and engine-facing delivery constraints.

presentation_route.business_question: Can many scene assets be turned into a dry-run publish queue with receipts?
presentation_route.operator_action: Discover scene assets, build the queue, run dry-run, and export the report.
presentation_route.core_logic: Convert discovered assets into protocol/material/texture/visual/export tasks and produce per-asset receipts.
presentation_route.evidence_to_show: Queue rows, dry-run events, receipts, orchestrator report.
presentation_route.reviewer_value: Shows how individual tools become a governed production workflow.

presentation_route.business_question: Can the full asset handoff be judged as a batch instead of five separate demos?
presentation_route.operator_action: Use Asset Handoff Gate: Fixture, Evaluate Gate, Preview Actions, Export Packet.
presentation_route.core_logic: Merge protocol, rule, texture, visual and queue evidence into per-asset Ready/Review/Blocked gates.
presentation_route.evidence_to_show: Handoff asset rows, action preview rows, exported handoff packet.
presentation_route.reviewer_value: Shows the portfolio has a production workflow, not only individual module proofs.

demo_script.operator_action: Run show_portfolio() from Maya Script Editor or shelf.
demo_script.talk_track: This is a Maya-hosted toolbench. The browser build is only the embedded UI surface.
demo_script.evidence_expected: AuroraView panel opens with Maya Bridge connected.

demo_script.operator_action: Click DCC Showcase Runbook / Build Plan.
demo_script.talk_track: The runbook lists each production problem, its Maya API entry, and the proof artifact.
demo_script.evidence_expected: Five module rows appear in the right rail.

demo_script.operator_action: Click Run Smoke or Export Package.
demo_script.talk_track: The tool creates public synthetic Maya fixtures, runs all DCC adapters, and writes JSON artifacts.
demo_script.evidence_expected: Five module artifacts are generated, with no Blocked module.

demo_script.operator_action: Open each module from the left navigation and inspect its DCC panel.
demo_script.talk_track: Each module exposes its own business loop: protocol, rules, visual review, texture delivery, and batch orchestration.
demo_script.evidence_expected: Each module shows scene facts, gate rows, output path, and raw JSON.

demo_script.operator_action: Click Asset Handoff Gate / Fixture, Evaluate Gate, Preview Actions, Export Packet.
demo_script.talk_track: The composite gate proves the five module evidence streams can become one asset handoff decision.
demo_script.evidence_expected: maya-asset-handoff-gate JSON contains 2 assets, 1 Ready, 1 Review, 0 Blocked.

demo_script.operator_action: Use Export Package and open the artifact path.
demo_script.talk_track: The final claim is machine-checkable: DCC-backed evidence exists for every module and for the composite handoff gate.
demo_script.evidence_expected: maya-dcc-showcase-runbook-package JSON contains plan, smoke, presentation, handoff gate, and artifacts.

gui_click_checklist.target: Cross-DCC Rule Matrix / Maya Scene Rule Run
Visual Review Studio / Maya Capture Setup
Texture Delivery Console / Maya Texture Inspection

steps: Use DCC Showcase Runbook in the right rail to build the plan.
Run smoke to create synthetic scene fixtures and execute all module adapters.
Run Asset Handoff Gate to evaluate the composite handoff workflow.
Open each module-specific panel to inspect the same evidence by business domain.
Export package to hand off a single JSON proof bundle.
plan.mutation_policy: Smoke creates synthetic demo nodes and JSON artifacts only; production scene mutation remains behind module-specific actions.

notes: ready node has protocol, material, file node, collision and LOD evidence
review node has valid protocol but intentionally lacks material and texture evidence

five module artifacts must be generated
asset handoff gate artifact must be generated
each artifact path must exist under maya-auroraview-host/artifacts
public case package must point to the latest DCC-first manifest
